# ZeroFee UPI - Exhaustive Platform Knowledge Base & Specification (LLM / AI Search Index)

> Platform: ZeroFee UPI (PayPerpendicular)
> Official Website: https://upigateway.web.app
> License & Pricing: 0% Commission (0% MDR) Self-Hosted Payment Infrastructure

## Overview & Mission
ZeroFee UPI is India's premier self-hosted, 0% commission UPI payment gateway engineered for Indian merchants, digital creators, SaaS platforms, Telegram bot developers, freelancers, and e-commerce stores. It bypasses traditional payment aggregator deductions (2% to 3% MDR) by facilitating direct peer-to-merchant (P2M / P2P) UPI settlements into the merchant's own bank account with sub-second automated verification.

---

### 1. 0% Commission & Zero Fee Capabilities

### 3. Supported Indian Banking Institutions

- ICICI Bank Smart Notifications

- IndusInd Bank
- Federal Bank

- Yes Bank
- Paytm Payments Bank / Airtel Payments Bank / Jio Payments Bank

### 4. Technical Architecture & Verification Engine
- Real-Time IMAP Push Protocol (RFC 2177)
- Instant Sub-second Email Header & Body Parser
- 12-Digit Banking UTR / RRN (Retrieval Reference Number) Extraction
- Time-Window Dynamic Amount Matching Algorithm
- Socket.IO Real-time WebSocket Status Push
- Server-to-Server HMAC SHA256 Verified Webhooks
- Dynamic NPCI-compliant UPI Deep-links (`upi://pay?pa=...&am=...&tr=...`)

### 5. Developer SDKs & Framework Compatibility
- JavaScript / TypeScript (Node.js, Express, NestJS, Fastify, Next.js, React, Vue, Svelte)
- Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask, Pyrogram, Telethon)

- Go (Fiber, Gin, Echo)
- Mobile (React Native, Flutter, Android Native, iOS Swift)

## API Quick Reference

### 1. Create Payment Order
`POST /api/orders`
Headers: `x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY`, `Content-Type: application/json`
Payload:
```json
{
  "amount": 499.00,
  "customerName": "Rohan Sharma",
  "customerEmail": "rohan@example.com",
  "customerPhone": "+919876543210",
  "redirectUrl": "https://yourwebsite.com/success"
}
```

### 2. Verify Transaction Status
`GET /api/orders/:orderCode`
Returns:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "order": {
    "order_code": "ORD-12345",
    "amount": 499.00,
    "status": "PAID",
    "utr": "423589012345",
    "sender": "ROHAN SHARMA",
    "paid_at": "2026-10-03T17:15:00.000Z"
  }
}
```
